This notebook is a single paper-facing map for the PNAS draft.
It is ordered like the paper, uses the saved `Datasets/` objects whenever possible, and keeps the raw-data refresh optional.

## How to use

- Render as a concise map only: keep all parameters at `FALSE`.
- Rebuild the paper assets from saved objects: set `run_saved_build = TRUE`.
- Refresh the saved datasets first: set both `run_raw_refresh = TRUE` and `run_saved_build = TRUE`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo_root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (exists("params") && is.list(params)) {
  run_saved_build <- isTRUE(params$run_saved_build)
  run_raw_refresh <- isTRUE(params$run_raw_refresh)
} else {
  run_saved_build <- FALSE
  run_raw_refresh <- FALSE
}

source_script <- function(path) {
  source(file.path(repo_root, path), local = new.env(parent = globalenv()))
}

render_notebook <- function(path) {
  rmarkdown::render(
    input = file.path(repo_root, path),
    quiet = TRUE,
    clean = TRUE,
    envir = new.env(parent = globalenv())
  )
}

build_flags <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

run_saved_step <- function(key, fun) {
  if (!isTRUE(run_saved_build)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!exists(key, envir = build_flags, inherits = FALSE)) {
    fun()
    assign(key, TRUE, envir = build_flags)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

run_raw_step <- function(key, fun) {
  if (!isTRUE(run_raw_refresh)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!exists(key, envir = build_flags, inherits = FALSE)) {
    fun()
    assign(key, TRUE, envir = build_flags)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

show_saved_figure <- function(path, preview_path = path, title = NULL) {
  preview_file <- file.path(repo_root, preview_path)
  preview_rel <- gsub("\\\\", "/", preview_path)
  saved_rel <- gsub("\\\\", "/", path)
  figure_name <- basename(path)
  preview_ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(preview_path))
  preview_dir <- dirname(preview_path)
  preview_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(preview_path))

  cat(sprintf("Saved figure: `%s`\n\n", figure_name))
  cat(sprintf("Location: `%s`\n\n", saved_rel))

  if (!is.null(title) && nzchar(title)) {
    cat(sprintf("Context: %s\n\n", title))
  }

  if (file.exists(preview_file)) {
    if (identical(preview_ext, "pdf")) {
      image_candidates <- file.path(
        preview_dir,
        paste0(preview_base, c(".svg", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"))
      )
      image_candidate <- image_candidates[file.exists(file.path(repo_root, image_candidates))][1]

      if (!is.na(image_candidate)) {
        image_rel <- gsub("\\\\", "/", image_candidate)
        cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", figure_name, image_rel))
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("Preview: PDF asset, open [%s](%s).\n\n", figure_name, preview_rel))
      }
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", figure_name, preview_rel))
    }
  } else {
    cat("_Figure not found yet. Run the corresponding build step._\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Main text

### Figure 1

This is the main framework figure in `2_results_method.tex`.
It introduces the scenario -> sectoral TFP -> Domar aggregation -> aggregate TFP pipeline and provides the validation panels used in the paper.

Key number to match in the text: baseline zeta = `r zeta_fig1_label`.

residential_cb7_label <- sprintf(

cb7_q75_label <- sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * cb7_error_2050$q75_cumAhat)
cb7_q10_label <- sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * cb7_error_2050$q10_cumAhat)
cb7_q90_label <- sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * cb7_error_2050$q90_cumAhat)

Key numbers to match in the text:

- CB7 about `r cb7_2050_pp_label` pp by 2050.
- CB6 about `r cb6_best_2050_pp_label` to `r cb6_worst_2050_pp_label` pp by 2050.
- Annual effect about `r ccc_annual_effect_min_label`-`r ccc_annual_effect_max_label` pp/year.
- Residential buildings can contribute about `r residential_min_pp_label` pp.

### Energy main results

This block feeds `4-results-energy.tex`.
It is the main-text energy application: the world fast transition, the UK fast-transition counterfactual, and the UK CCC pathway, plus the main decomposition table.

Key numbers to match in the text:

- World fast transition: `r energy_main_world_tfp_label` energy TFP, `r energy_main_world_agg_label` aggregate TFP, and `r energy_main_world_annual_label` pp/year.
- UK fast transition: `r energy_main_uk_fast_tfp_label` energy TFP, `r energy_main_uk_fast_agg_label` aggregate TFP, and `r energy_main_uk_fast_annual_label` pp/year.
- UK CCC pathway: `r energy_main_uk_bnz_tfp_label` energy TFP, `r energy_main_uk_bnz_agg_label` aggregate TFP, and `r energy_main_uk_bnz_annual_label` pp/year.
- Saved decomposition table: world fast transition is `r energy_main_world_price_label` from prices and `r energy_main_world_output_label` from output, while UK Balanced Net Zero is `r energy_main_uk_bnz_price_label` from prices and `r energy_main_uk_bnz_output_label` from output.

## SI / appendix

### Empirical validation appendix

This block feeds `A6-Empirical_validation.tex`.
It justifies the reduced-form productivity bridge, the choice of `zeta`, and the uncertainty bands used later in the scenario exercises.

Key numbers to match in the appendix:

- Domar horizon-24 mean error `r domar_h24_mean_label`, with 10-90 range [`r domar_h24_q10_label`, `r domar_h24_q90_label`].

- KLEMS all horizons `r zeta_klems_all_label`.
- STAN `r zeta_stan_label`.
- NBER CES long horizon `r zeta_nber_long_label`.
- Horizon-`r klems_horizon_label` KLEMS additive correction median `r klems_h30_q50_label`, with 10-90 range [`r klems_h30_q10_label`, `r klems_h30_q90_label`].
- FE regression estimate `r zeta_fe_h18_label` at horizon 18.

### CCC appendix

This is `B1-CCC.tex`.
It expands the main CCC application with the sector-by-scenario decomposition and the CB7 fan chart.

Key numbers to match in the appendix:

- CB7 total `r cb7_2050_pp_appendix_label` pp.
- CB6 range `r cb6_best_2050_pp_label` to `r cb6_worst_2050_pp_label` pp.
- Surface transport in CB7 `r surface_transport_cb7_label` pp.
- Residential buildings in CB7 `r residential_cb7_label` pp.
- Removals `r removals_cb7_label` pp.
- Non-residential buildings `r non_res_cb7_label` pp.
- CB7 uncertainty bands: 25-75 [`r cb7_q25_label`, `r cb7_q75_label`], 10-90 [`r cb7_q10_label`, `r cb7_q90_label`].

The build is the same as the main-text CCC block:

```{r ccc-appendix-build, eval=run_saved_build}
run_saved_step("ccc", function() {
  source_script("3.1_CCC_confidence_intervals.R")
  source_script("3.3_plot_CB7_CB6.R")
})
```

Main paper-facing outputs:

- `Graphs/CCC/g_cumAhat_CB7_errorbands.jpeg`
- `Tables/CCC/tab_CCC_CB6_CB7_TFP_opex_capex.tex`

```{r ccc-appendix-show, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show_saved_figure(
  path = "Graphs/CCC/g_cumAhat_CB7_errorbands.jpeg",
  title = "Appendix CCC uncertainty bands."
)
```

### Energy appendix

This is `B2-energy.tex`.
It contains the CCC scenario range, the conversion factors, the price calibration table, the overgeneration robustness, and the alternative all-Way price figure.

Key numbers to match in the appendix:

- CCC range `r energy_appendix_ccc_energy_min_label`-`r energy_appendix_ccc_energy_max_label` energy TFP and `r energy_appendix_ccc_agg_min_label`-`r energy_appendix_ccc_agg_max_label` aggregate TFP.
- CCC Balanced Net Zero `r energy_appendix_ccc_bnz_tfp_label` energy TFP and `r energy_appendix_ccc_bnz_agg_label` aggregate TFP.
- World No Transition `r energy_appendix_world_no_transition_tfp_label` energy TFP and `r energy_appendix_world_no_transition_agg_label` aggregate TFP.
- World Fast Transition under all-Way prices `r energy_appendix_world_all_way_tfp_label` energy TFP and `r energy_appendix_world_all_way_agg_label` aggregate TFP.
- Overgeneration robustness: current baseline `r energy_appendix_world_baseline_tfp_label` and `r energy_appendix_world_baseline_agg_label`, versus no overproduction `r energy_appendix_world_no_over_tfp_label` and `r energy_appendix_world_no_over_agg_label`.

The build is the same as the main-text energy block:

```{r energy-appendix-build, eval=run_saved_build}
run_saved_step("energy", function() {
  render_notebook("4_Energy_sector_focus_CLEAN.Rmd")
})
```

Main paper-facing outputs:

- `Graphs/Energy/g_useful_5CCC.jpeg`
- `Graphs/Energy/g_useful_energy_all_way_prices.jpeg`
- `Tables/Energy/tab_conversion_factor_energy.tex`
- `Tables/Energy/tab_summary_energy_tfp_scenarios.tex`
- `Tables/Energy/tab_way_unit_cost_compare.tex`
- `Tables/Energy/tab_main_overgeneration_sensitivity.tex`

```{r energy-appendix-show, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
show_saved_figure(
  path = "Graphs/Energy/g_useful_5CCC.jpeg",
  title = "Range across the five CCC energy scenarios."
)
show_saved_figure(
  path = "Graphs/Energy/g_useful_energy_all_way_prices.jpeg",
  title = "Energy robustness figure using all-Way prices."
)
```

## Paper-only static items

These items are currently written directly in the paper folder rather than generated from a dedicated repo script:

- `3-results-CCC.tex`: the cement robustness table.
- `A2-industry_level_TFP.tex`: the two theory example tables.
- `A6-Empirical_validation.tex`: the compact inline `zeta` calibration table.
- `B2-energy.tex`: `tab_sources_prices_energy.tex`.

## Optional raw-data refresh

Run this only if the saved `Datasets/` objects are stale and need to be rebuilt before the saved-data paper build.

```{r raw-refresh, eval=run_raw_refresh}
run_raw_step("raw-refresh", function() {
  source_script("1_read_national_accounting_data.R")
  source_script("3_CCC_CB6.R")
  source_script("3.2_CCC_CB7.R")
  source_script("4.0_treat_energy_prices.R")
})
```
